name: author: with an OR keyword clause
when: a person's OWN writings on a theme (people WRITING, never people the literature is about)
shape: author:"F* Surname" ("term a" OR term-b OR "term c") — wildcard initial + surname, multi-word terms quoted, one OR group
yields: the author's works on the theme in one page, including variant spellings of the initial
misses: a spelled-out first name returns nothing; homonymous authors share the F* form
